summary: Blackboard tip: If you are adding an @internetarchive video using the WYSIWYG editor click on the button, choose HTML5 video, cut and paste the link it but change /details/ to /download/ otherwise video will not work. #HigherEd #edtechchat
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Blackboard tip: If you are adding an @internetarchive video using the WYSIWYG editor click on the button, choose HTML5 video, cut and paste the link it but change /details/ to /download/ otherwise video will not work. #HigherEd #edtechchat
